title: 2022 AMC 12A Problem 3
statement: Five rectangles, \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) \(D,\) and \(E,\) are arranged in a square as shown below. These rectangles have dimensions \(1\times6,\) \(2\times4,\) \(5\times6,\) \(2\times7,\) and \(2\times3,\) respectively. (The figure is not drawn to scale.) Which of the five rectangles is the shaded one in the middle?

solutions.text:
The five areas are \(6,\ 8,\ 30,\ 14,\) and \(6,\) which sum to \(64.\) So the square is \(8\times8.\)

Placing \(C\) (\(5\times6\)) across the top left, \(D\) (\(2\times7\)) up the right side, \(E\) (\(2\times3\)) in the lower left, and \(A\) (\(1\times6\)) along the bottom leaves a central \(2\times4\) gap, which is exactly rectangle \(B.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The five areas add to the square’s area, which fixes the side length
Anchor the large \(5\times6\) and \(2\times7\) pieces in corners, then fit the rest
